question_en: Which statements are true for an ideal gas? 1) $pV=\nu RT$ holds for any mass. 2) At the same $p$, $T$, $1\ \mathrm{mol}$ of any gas occupies the same volume. 3) At constant $p$ the density does not depend on $T$. 4) At the same $p$, $T$ the number density is the same for all gases.
question_uz: Ideal gaz uchun qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) $pV=\nu RT$ istalgan massa uchun o'rinli. 2) Bir xil $p$, $T$ da istalgan gazning $1\ \mathrm{mol}$ i bir xil hajmni egallaydi. 3) $p$ o'zgarmasa, zichlik $T$ ga bog'liq emas. 4) Bir xil $p$, $T$ da konsentratsiya hamma gazda bir xil.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны для идеального газа? 1) $pV=\nu RT$ справедливо для любой массы. 2) При одинаковых $p$, $T$ $1\ \mathrm{mol}$ любого газа занимает одинаковый объём. 3) При постоянном $p$ плотность не зависит от $T$. 4) При одинаковых $p$, $T$ концентрация у всех газов одинакова.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. 1, 2, 4 holat tenglamasidan kelib chiqadi; 3 noto'g'ri: ρ = pM/(RT), p o'zgarmasa ρ ∼ 1/T.
Asos: pV = νRT, p = nkT.

uz: 1 va 2 — holat tenglamasidan: $V=\frac{\nu RT}{p}$ gaz turiga bog'liq emas.
ru: 1 и 2 — из уравнения состояния: $V=\frac{\nu RT}{p}$ не зависит от рода газа.
en: 1 and 2 follow from the equation of state: $V=\frac{\nu RT}{p}$ does not depend on the type of gas.
3 is false: $\rho=\frac{pM}{RT}$, the density decreases on heating.

distractors_en.A: statement 4 is also true: n = p/(kT)
distractors_en.C: statement 3 is false, while 1 is true
distractors_en.D: statement 3 is false, while 2 is true

question_en: $0.16\ \mathrm{kg}$ of methane ($M=16\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) in a vessel of volume $50\ \mathrm{L}$ produce a pressure of $498.6\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Find the temperature of the methane ($^\circ\mathrm{C}$).

question_en: The mass of an ideal gas in a closed cylinder is increased $3$ times and its absolute temperature is decreased $6$ times. How does the pressure change?
question_uz: Yopiq ballondagi ideal gazning massasi $3$ marta oshirildi, absolyut temperaturasi esa $6$ marta kamaytirildi. Bosim qanday o'zgaradi?
question_ru: Массу идеального газа в закрытом баллоне увеличили в $3$ раза, а абсолютную температуру уменьшили в $6$ раз. Как изменится давление?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. V o'zgarmas: p ∼ mT, p₂/p₁ = 3·(1/6) = 1/2 — bosim 2 marta kamayadi.
Asos: pV = (m/M)RT.

uz: $V$ va $M$ o'zgarmas — bosim massa va temperatura ko'paytmasiga proporsional: $$\frac{p_2}{p_1}=\frac{m_2}{m_1}\cdot\frac{T_2}{T_1}=3\cdot\frac{1}{6}=\frac{1}{2}$$
ru: $V$ и $M$ постоянны — давление пропорционально произведению массы на температуру: $$\frac{p_2}{p_1}=\frac{m_2}{m_1}\cdot\frac{T_2}{T_1}=3\cdot\frac{1}{6}=\frac{1}{2}$$
en: $V$ and $M$ are constant — the pressure is proportional to the product of mass and temperature: $$\frac{p_2}{p_1}=\frac{m_2}{m_1}\cdot\frac{T_2}{T_1}=3\cdot\frac{1}{6}=\frac{1}{2}$$

distractors.E: massa o'zgarishi bosimga ta'sir qilmaydi deb olingan

distractors_ru.E: считали, что масса не влияет на давление

distractors_en.C: the temperature was taken as increasing: 3·6
distractors_en.D: the mass was also taken as decreasing
distractors_en.E: it was assumed that the mass does not affect the pressure

question_en: Two vessels of equal volume contain helium ($M=4\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) and methane ($M=16\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) of equal temperature and mass. What is the ratio of the helium pressure to the methane pressure $\frac{p_1}{p_2}$?
question_uz: Bir xil hajmli ikki idishda temperaturasi va massasi bir xil bo'lgan geliy ($M=4\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) va metan ($M=16\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) bor. Geliy bosimining metan bosimiga nisbati $\frac{p_1}{p_2}$ qanday?
question_ru: В двух сосудах одинакового объёма находятся гелий ($M=4\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) и метан ($M=16\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) одинаковой температуры и массы. Чему равно отношение давления гелия к давлению метана $\frac{p_1}{p_2}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Teng m, V, T da p ∼ 1/M: p₁/p₂ = M₂/M₁ = 16/4 = 4.
Asos: pV = (m/M)RT.

uz: $m$, $V$, $T$ bir xil — bosim molyar massaga teskari proporsional: $$\frac{p_1}{p_2}=\frac{M_2}{M_1}=\frac{16}{4}=4$$
ru: $m$, $V$, $T$ одинаковы — давление обратно пропорционально молярной массе: $$\frac{p_1}{p_2}=\frac{M_2}{M_1}=\frac{16}{4}=4$$
en: $m$, $V$, $T$ are the same — the pressure is inversely proportional to the molar mass: $$\frac{p_1}{p_2}=\frac{M_2}{M_1}=\frac{16}{4}=4$$

distractors.A: bosim molyar massaga to'g'ri proporsional deb olingan
distractors.B: bosim gaz turiga bog'liq emas deb olingan

question_en: Find the density of helium ($M=4\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) at a pressure of $332.4\ \mathrm{kPa}$ and a temperature of $400\ \mathrm{K}$ ($\mathrm{kg/m^3}$).
question_uz: $332.4\ \mathrm{kPa}$ bosim va $400\ \mathrm{K}$ temperaturadagi geliyning ($M=4\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) zichligini toping ($\mathrm{kg/m^3}$).
question_ru: Найдите плотность гелия ($M=4\ \mathrm{g/mol}$) при давлении $332.4\ \mathrm{kPa}$ и температуре $400\ \mathrm{K}$ ($\mathrm{kg/m^3}$).
explanation_200:

question_en: The absolute temperature of an ideal gas increased $2$ times and its pressure increased $6$ times. How did the density of the gas change?
question_uz: Ideal gazning absolyut temperaturasi $2$ marta, bosimi $6$ marta ortdi. Gaz zichligi qanday o'zgardi?

Asos: gaz zichligi formulasi.

question_en: A vessel of volume $6\ \mathrm{L}$ contains gas at $300\ \mathrm{K}$ and $200\ \mathrm{kPa}$. The gas is transferred to a vessel of volume $4\ \mathrm{L}$ and its temperature is brought to $500\ \mathrm{K}$. What pressure is established ($\mathrm{kPa}$)?
question_uz: $6\ \mathrm{L}$ hajmli idishda $300\ \mathrm{K}$ temperatura va $200\ \mathrm{kPa}$ bosimli gaz bor. Gaz $4\ \mathrm{L}$ hajmli idishga o'tkazilib, temperaturasi $500\ \mathrm{K}$ ga yetkazildi. Qanday bosim qaror topadi ($\mathrm{kPa}$)?
question_ru: В сосуде объёмом $6\ \mathrm{L}$ находится газ при температуре $300\ \mathrm{K}$ и давлении $200\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Газ перевели в сосуд объёмом $4\ \mathrm{L}$ и довели его температуру до $500\ \mathrm{K}$. Какое давление установится ($\mathrm{kPa}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. p₂ = p₁(V₁/V₂)(T₂/T₁) = 200·1,5·(5/3) = 500 kPa.
Asos: Klapeyron tenglamasi.

question_en: A gas of volume $0.6\ \mathrm{m^3}$ has a pressure of $200\ \mathrm{kPa}$ at $300\ \mathrm{K}$. What is the temperature of this gas if at $250\ \mathrm{kPa}$ it occupies $1.2\ \mathrm{m^3}$ ($\mathrm{K}$)?
question_uz: $0.6\ \mathrm{m^3}$ hajmdagi gazning $300\ \mathrm{K}$ dagi bosimi $200\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Shu gaz $250\ \mathrm{kPa}$ bosimda $1.2\ \mathrm{m^3}$ hajmni egallasa, uning temperaturasi qanday ($\mathrm{K}$)?
question_ru: Давление газа объёмом $0.6\ \mathrm{m^3}$ при $300\ \mathrm{K}$ равно $200\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Какова температура этого газа, если при давлении $250\ \mathrm{kPa}$ он занимает объём $1.2\ \mathrm{m^3}$ ($\mathrm{K}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. T₂ = T₁(p₂/p₁)(V₂/V₁) = 300·1,25·2 = 750 K.
Asos: Klapeyron tenglamasi.

en: The mass does not change, $T\sim pV$: $$T_2=T_1\frac{p_2}{p_1}\cdot\frac{V_2}{V_1}=300\cdot\frac{250}{200}\cdot\frac{1.2}{0.6}=750\ \mathrm{K}$$

question_en: In some process for an ideal gas $\frac{V^2}{T}=\mathrm{const}$. How does the pressure change if the volume increases $3$ times at constant mass?
question_uz: Biror jarayonda ideal gaz uchun $\frac{V^2}{T}=\mathrm{const}$. Gaz massasi o'zgarmay hajmi $3$ marta ortganda, bosimi qanday o'zgaradi?
question_ru: В некотором процессе для идеального газа $\frac{V^2}{T}=\mathrm{const}$. Как изменится давление, если при неизменной массе объём газа увеличится в $3$ раза?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. T ∼ V², holat tenglamasidan p ∼ T/V ∼ V: bosim 3 marta ortadi.
Asos: pV = νRT.

ru: Из процесса $T\sim V^2$, из уравнения состояния $p\sim\frac{T}{V}$: $$p\sim\frac{V^2}{V}=V,\qquad \frac{p_2}{p_1}=3$$
en: From the process $T\sim V^2$, and from the equation of state $p\sim\frac{T}{V}$: $$p\sim\frac{V^2}{V}=V,\qquad \frac{p_2}{p_1}=3$$

distractors.B: bosim hajmga teskari proporsional deb olingan
distractors.E: bosim hajm kvadratiga teskari deb olingan

question_en: A vessel contains a mixture of $2\ \mathrm{mol}$ of nitrogen and $3\ \mathrm{mol}$ of helium at a total pressure of $150\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Find the partial pressures of nitrogen and helium ($\mathrm{kPa}$).
question_uz: Idishda $2\ \mathrm{mol}$ azot va $3\ \mathrm{mol}$ geliy aralashmasi bor, umumiy bosim $150\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Azot va geliyning parsial bosimlarini toping ($\mathrm{kPa}$).
question_ru: В сосуде смесь $2\ \mathrm{mol}$ азота и $3\ \mathrm{mol}$ гелия, общее давление $150\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Найдите парциальные давления азота и гелия ($\mathrm{kPa}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Parsial bosimlar modda miqdorlariga proporsional: p₁ = 150·2/5 = 60, p₂ = 150·3/5 = 90 kPa.
Asos: Dalton qonuni.

en: Partial pressures are proportional to $\nu$: $$p_1=150\cdot\frac{2}{5}=60\ \mathrm{kPa},\qquad p_2=150\cdot\frac{3}{5}=90\ \mathrm{kPa}$$

distractors.E: geliy bosimi umumiy bosimga teng deb olingan

distractors_en.B: the amounts of substance were swapped
distractors_en.C: the pressure was split equally between the gases
distractors_en.D: the pressure was distributed by mass
distractors_en.E: the helium pressure was taken as the total pressure

question_en: A vessel of volume $2\ \mathrm{L}$ contains gas at $300\ \mathrm{kPa}$, and a vessel of volume $3\ \mathrm{L}$ contains gas at $100\ \mathrm{kPa}$. What pressure is established after the tap between them is opened, if the temperature does not change ($\mathrm{kPa}$)?
question_uz: $2\ \mathrm{L}$ hajmli idishda $300\ \mathrm{kPa}$, $3\ \mathrm{L}$ hajmli idishda $100\ \mathrm{kPa}$ bosimli gaz bor. Idishlar orasidagi jo'mrak ochilgach, temperatura o'zgarmasa, qanday bosim qaror topadi ($\mathrm{kPa}$)?
question_ru: В сосуде объёмом $2\ \mathrm{L}$ газ под давлением $300\ \mathrm{kPa}$, в сосуде объёмом $3\ \mathrm{L}$ — под давлением $100\ \mathrm{kPa}$. Какое давление установится после открытия крана между сосудами, если температура не меняется ($\mathrm{kPa}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. p = (p₁V₁ + p₂V₂)/(V₁ + V₂) = (600 + 300)/5 = 180 kPa.
Asos: T o'zgarmas, modda miqdorlari qo'shiladi.

en: $T$ is constant — the products $pV$ add up: $$p=\frac{p_1V_1+p_2V_2}{V_1+V_2}=\frac{600+300}{5}=180\ \mathrm{kPa}$$

distractors_en.A: the simple average of the pressures was taken
distractors_en.E: the result was not divided by the total volume

question_en: As gas from a cylinder was used, its mass decreased by $25$ percent and its pressure decreased $1.5$ times. How many times did the absolute temperature of the gas decrease?
question_uz: Ballondagi gaz ishlatilganda uning massasi $25$ foizga, bosimi esa $1.5$ marta kamaydi. Gazning absolyut temperaturasi necha marta kamaygan?
question_ru: При расходовании газа из баллона его масса уменьшилась на $25$ процентов, а давление — в $1.5$ раза. Во сколько раз уменьшилась абсолютная температура газа?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. V o'zgarmas: T ∼ p/m, T₂/T₁ = (2/3)/(3/4) = 8/9 — 1,125 marta kamaygan.
Asos: pV = (m/M)RT.

en: $V$ is constant — the temperature is proportional to $\frac{p}{m}$, $m_2=0.75m_1$: $$\frac{T_2}{T_1}=\frac{p_2}{p_1}\cdot\frac{m_1}{m_2}=\frac{2}{3}\cdot\frac{4}{3}=\frac{8}{9}$$

distractors_en.A: the mass was taken as decreasing 1.25 times
distractors_en.C: the change in mass was ignored
